person_note: The Goodreads evidence exposes Alex Cross narrating participating events as “I,” while the authorized opening sustains third-person narration of Brianne Parker. AudioFile and Yenra explicitly confirm that the novel shifts between Cross’s first-person sections and third-person criminal/Mastermind sections. Under the methodology, these are sustained base sections in different grammatical persons, so the result is ALTERNATING rather than FIRST; the third-person opening is not merely dialogue or an embedded document. BookRags’ broad first-person description is treated as shorthand for the dominant Cross strand because it does not reconcile the demonstrable third-person chapters. Confidence is medium, not high: the direct whole-book alternating descriptions are Tier C, the Tier A prose covers only the opening, and the AudioFile review concerns an abridged edition.
